premises.text: Stand-up comedy is a popular interest among a large audience
premises.evidence_span: 91 million of them said that stand-up comedy is one of their top five interests

premises.text: The market for comedy albums has declined significantly
premises.evidence_span: people no longer buy comedy albums anymore now they stream albums

premises.text: Streaming platforms do not provide sufficient comedy content
premises.evidence_span: only 10% of the comedy that's available and only 1% of the market

premises.text: Laughley is a streaming app specifically designed for stand-up comedy
premises.evidence_span: the very first app that's built from the ground up to focus on streaming comedy

premises.text: The app features a profanity filter for family-friendly listening
premises.evidence_span: you can actually turn on the profanity filtering and it all of a sudden weeds out anything that's got dirty words in it

premises.text: Subscription offers ad-free access and exclusive content
premises.evidence_span: for seven dollars and 99 cents a month you get ad free you get offline play and you get access to exclusive content

premises.text: The technology allows for transcribing jokes for better searchability
premises.evidence_span: we have a technology which allows us to transcribe every single joke in the text

premises.text: Comedians promote the app to their followers as part of a revenue-sharing model
premises.evidence_span: we share revenue with them for every single stream

premises.text: Distribution partnerships with record labels enhance market reach

value.text: Fans of stand-up comedy can access a wide range of content through Laughley
value.evidence_span: the very first app that's built from the ground up to focus on streaming comedy

notes: Statistics on social media followers and traction details are excluded as they do not meet premise criteria.
